classification.difficultyReason: The z-score formula is supplied with values already substituted, and the student only rearranges 1.5 = 12/σ to get σ = 8. That is one rearrangement with the unknown in the denominator and a decimal division, plus simplifying 84−72. It is a little harder than the direct-application items (p13-q5, p29-q1) because the unknown sits in the denominator. It is easier than p15-q11, where the student must recall the formula, choose the substitution and handle a negative z-score without any set-up.
